caveats: This is one year of reported construction, not the stock of all buildings, housing units or a register of planning approvals. Additions and alterations affect existing buildings and cannot be added to new construction as a count of new buildings. District totals do not locate projects or establish their occupancy, value or legal status. Four non-residential floor-space figures have misplaced commas in the PDF; their digits are retained with reviewed grouping and the original tokens remain attached to the observations.
The source uses .. for unavailable figures and a dash for nil or negligible. Both retain their printed token and a distinct status; neither is converted to an exact zero.
grain: One 2024 construction category, count or floor-space measure, and district; national totals overlap districts
notes: DCS figures for all 25 districts and the national total in 2024. The table distinguishes new residential buildings, new non-residential buildings, and additions or alterations. Each category has a building count and floor space in square feet.
